basic_details.job_title: BRIC-NIPGR Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Senior Research Fellow / Project Associate II Posts
basic_details.short_information: BRIC-National Institute of Plant Genome Research (BRIC-NIPGR), New Delhi, has invited applications for one purely temporary Senior Research Fellow/Project Associate-II position in the DBT project "Functional characterization of genome-edited lines for discovering novel genes regulating grain mineral contents in Indica rice", under Dr. Hasthi Ram, Scientist. Emoluments are Rs. 42000/- + 27% HRA as per DST/DBT norms. Applications go through a Google form within 15 days from the date of advertisement (notice dated 16 November 2026), which works out to about 1 December 2026.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 15 days from the date of advertisement; about 1 December 2026 (15 days from 16 November 2026)

how_to_apply: Candidates apply by filling in the Google form linked in the notice, within 15 days from the date of advertisement. The notice is dated 16 November 2026.
Open the Google form given in the notice (see Important Links).
Fill in the necessary information, using exactly the same name as in the certificate and application.
Upload scanned copies of all certificates/marksheets (from Xth standard onwards) of educational qualification and experience, in a single PDF.

Only the soft copy of the application in the Google form will be accepted. Candidates applying with incomplete information will not be considered for an interview. For clarification, candidates may contact the scientist in charge through email only: [email protected].
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the online interview. Canvassing in any form or bringing influence, political or otherwise, will lead to disqualification of the candidate(s). Ineligible candidates will not be interviewed.

content_sections.heading: BRIC-NIPGR Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: BRIC-National Institute of Plant Genome Research
Functional characterization of genome-edited lines for discovering novel genes regulating grain mineral contents in Indica rice (DBT project)
Emoluments Rs. 42000/- + 27% HRA as per DST/DBT norms
Within 15 days from the date of advertisement; about 1 December 2026 (15 days from 16 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: About BRIC-NIPGR
content_sections.text: BRIC-National Institute of Plant Genome Research is located at Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi-110067 (JNU Campus). The post is in a DBT project supervised by Dr. Hasthi Ram, Scientist IV, who signs the notice.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives separate qualifications for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Project Associate-II (PA-II) posts. It advertises one post in total. Printed after the Project Associate-II qualification: candidates with research experience in rice, plant phenotyping, plant molecular biology, miRNAs are strongly encouraged to apply, and candidates with one or more of these areas will be preferred. Reservation of posts shall be as per Govt. of India norms. Candidates must ascertain their eligibility before applying, as ineligible candidates will not be interviewed. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in any branch of Biological/Life Sciences with 60% (or equivalent) marks, OR an equivalent degree in any branch of Biological/Life Sciences with two years post-master's research experience; and fulfilling the criteria in DST Office Memorandum number DST/PCPM/Z-06/2022 dated 26/06/2023.

Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/MVSc or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent; fulfilling the guidelines of DST-OM number SR/S9/Z-05/2019 dated July 10, 2020; and two years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 42000/- + 27% HRA as per DST/DBT norms. The fellowship amount is as sanctioned in the project and as per DBT/DST norms. The position is completely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for one year or till the tenability of the project, whichever is earlier. The tenure can be curtailed based on the assessment of the candidate's performance and the discretion of the Competent Authority. The appointment may be terminated at any time by giving one-month notice by either side. Applicants have no claim, implicit or explicit, for consideration against any regular position of BRIC-NIPGR.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BRIC-NIPGR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Google form given in the notice (see Important Links). Fill in the necessary information, using exactly the same name as in the certificate and application. Upload scanned copies of all certificates/marksheets (from Xth standard onwards) of educational qualification and experience, in a single PDF. Only the soft copy of the application in the Google form will be accepted. Candidates applying with incomplete information will not be considered for an interview. For clarification, candidates may contact the scientist in charge through email only: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview, which will be a web interview. A link with the date and time of the online interview will be e-mailed to the shortlisted candidates only. BRIC-NIPGR reserves the right to select the candidate against the post depending upon the qualifications and experience of the candidate. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BRIC-NIPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one purely temporary post of Senior Research Fellow/Project Associate-II in the DBT project on genome-edited lines in Indica rice.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The notice asks for applications within 15 days from the date of advertisement. The notice is dated 16 November 2026, so the deadline is about 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in any branch of Biological/Life Sciences with 60% (or equivalent) marks, or an equivalent degree in Biological/Life Sciences with two years post-master's research experience, plus the DST OM DST/PCPM/Z-06/2022 criteria.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/MVSc or a bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine, with two years' R&D experience, under DST-OM SR/S9/Z-05/2019 dated July 10, 2020.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the post?
faq.answer: Emoluments are Rs. 42000/- + 27% HRA as per DST/DBT norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of Rs. 42000?
faq.answer: The notice states the emoluments as Rs. 42000/- + 27% HRA as per DST/DBT norms, so HRA is printed as an addition to the Rs. 42000.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the BRIC-NIPGR SRF/Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Fill in the Google form given in the notice and upload all certificates/marksheets from Xth standard onwards, plus experience documents, as a single PDF. Only the soft copy in the Google form is accepted.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are called for an online (web) interview. The link with date and time is e-mailed to shortlisted candidates only.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, initially for one year or till the tenability of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the online interview.
